doc.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023

title: Opening banter about keyboard players envying Shaffer
summary: Rowe greets Shaffer and jokes about keyboardists envying his career; Shaffer says he was blessed with right place, right time.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Paul Shaffer with me this morning for the Fillius Jazz Archive. It’s 11 AM-ish and that’s about the time most musicians get their mojo working. Thanks for joining me.
Yes. I cannot verify that my mojo is in fact working. However, if it is I certainly hope that it will work on you.

All right. I wanted to tell you about a little research I did recently, sort of unscientific, but I’ve determined that in the United States there’s approximately 3200 keyboard players who are somewhere between modestly envious or insanely jealous of Paul Shaffer’s career and accomplishments.
Well I don’t, you know, I’m sure you’re right because it’s just been, you know I’ve been so blessed, that’s all I can say, and talk about right place at the right time. I was. That’s all I can say.
